reviews.title: Unique PC case for modern builds
reviews.comment: Great case, fun to build in. Love the old school aesthetic. Plenty of air flow too.
reviews.author: Joel

reviews.title: Amazing Case
reviews.comment: Absolutely beautiful vintage looking case, temps are looking great. Recently built my pc but was in the market for one of these for a while. It’s a little small on the inside based on what you might expect, but was extremely easy to switch my build over. It’s extremely sturdy but also on the lighter side which is a huge plus, and although it might be expensive, it is hands down the best looking case vintage-style case on the market!
reviews.author: Matthew

reviews.title: A sleeper hit!
reviews.comment: While yes it's an expensive case I think it's worth every penny, it's very well built. If you grew up tinkering with PC's in the 90's you'll truly appreciate the rounded edges inside, no more randomly getting cut. It has plenty of room for modern hardware with some configuration. Great airflow with Arctic P12 Pro fans using the integrated fan hub controller. Weight is what you'd expect from an all metal case and it's easy to build in. Thank you SilverStone for bringing this to the masses!
reviews.author: Christian J. Hattery

reviews.title: Great Modern Case with a Retro Look.
reviews.comment: I absolutely love this case. It arrived in great condition and was packed very well. The modern necessities are implemented great with the retro look. There is plenty of space to work in and moves a lot of air with the preinstalled case fans,
reviews.author: DarthVaderVan
